results.segment: We are writing about your energy account for information only. There is nothing you need to send us.
Where the account is held jointly, both parties must sign the enclosed authority.
If you no longer keep a vehicle at this address, cancel the permit online.
Always shred documents showing your name and address before throwing them away.
Remember that we will never ask you for your password.

obligations.ask: Send a copy of the updated logbook

results.segment: If you have already registered the vehicle at your new address, please send a copy of the updated logbook.

obligations.ask: Continue with the payment plan and quote the plan number

results.segment: If you have already agreed a payment plan with our office, please continue with it and quote the plan number.
The next inspection is due in 18 months and we will arrange it.
